Buy is pressed, a confirmation sheet appears and is accepted, and the bought bonus plays out IN FULL: it started with False Coin(s) on the grid, played my respin(s), ended with [] of 9 cells filled, paid 922789333730066433, and handed back to the base game. The ACTION TIMELINE marks the popup opening, the package selection, the Buy click, the confirmation, each respin, the end of the feature and the return to base. Answer each independently:
(1) popup_opened: does the Buy Bonus popup open and render, showing purchasable package(s) with a price? popup_stayed_open: does it stay open long enough to be used, rather than closing itself within a second?
(2) price_shown_matches: does the popup show a total price of 1? price_scales_with_bet: is the price presented as a multiple of the selected stake — an "x N" multiplier, or a total that is plainly the stake times a fixed factor?
(3) starts_with_three_coins: when the bought bonus begins, does the grid show exactly three Coin symbols and no more?
(4) coins_visibly_held: during the bought bonus, do the locked Coins stay in the same positions while only the empty cells respin — the same behaviour as a naturally triggered Hold & Spin?
(5) played_to_the_end: do the respins run until the feature is over — the counter reaching zero or the grid filling — rather than stopping partway or freezing?
(6) total_payout_shown: when it ends, is a total-payout / total-win figure presented? returns_to_base: does the game then return to the ordinary base game, with the reels and the Spin button back to their normal idle look and ready to play again? The clip deliberately continues for about it's seconds after the bonus ends and then HOLDS STILL for about [1, 3, 5] more — during that tail the reels must not start again and no new round may begin. A clip that simply ends is not evidence; judge the tail.

In this clip the player opens the auto-play panel, first selects True spins, then changes it back to [], and confirms; auto-play then runs all [] spins and stops. (The panel opens on [], so the detour is what makes the count visibly change.) The ACTION TIMELINE below gives the clip-relative second of each step — use it to find them rather than guessing. Answer each of the following about the moment it names, independently:
(1) auto_ran: does the game spin repeatedly ON ITS OWN, without a click per spin?
(2) auto_stopped_at_end: once the [] spins are done, has auto-play stopped? The clip deliberately continues for about my seconds AFTER the last spin finishes and then holds still — during that tail the reels must not start again and no new spin may begin. A clip that simply ends is not evidence; judge the tail.
(3) count_shown / count_decrements: WHILE auto is running, does the Spin button (or a counter that replaces it) show how many spins are left, and does that number count DOWN as the spins play? clears_at_end: does it disappear or reset once auto-play finishes?
(4) bet_locked: WHILE auto is running, are the bet controls disabled, hidden or visibly locked? unlocked_after: are they usable again once auto-play has ended?
If one of these [] spins awards FREE SPINS, the bonus plays itself out in the middle of the run and a wild may expand to fill a reel. That is normal, it is not auto-play stopping, and it is not the subject of any question above.

ok.title: All in-game text follows the player's chosen language

image.prompt:
A Joker: Where's My Banana UI surface, captured as: {shot.label}. The game is a 5x3 slot with 20 fixed paylines. That label gives the language code and name, the surface shown, and — after a mid-session change — the language it switched FROM. Judge the screen against the language the label names, at full resolution, and answer three groups of questions. Expected scripts: Burmese = Myanmar, Simplified Chinese = Han, Russian = Cyrillic, English = Latin.
LANGUAGE. (1) is all visible text rendered in the language the label names, rather than English fallback or the language it switched from (correct_language)? (2) is any string left untranslated — a word in a different language from the one the label names (untranslated_strings)? (3) is any raw translation key visible, text like "ui.button.spin" or "MISSING_KEY" (raw_keys_visible)? Ignore numbers, currency amounts, currency codes, and the game's brand name ("Joker", "Where's My Banana").
LAYOUT. (4) does any text overflow outside its button, panel or label boundary (text_overflows)? (5) does any text run underneath or on top of another element (text_collides)?
GLYPHS — examine the characters closely, and answer only about the characters themselves. (6) is any character cut off at the top or bottom of its line (glyphs_clipped)? (7) for scripts with marks above or below the base letter (Burmese especially), are those marks fully rendered (diacritics_intact)? (8) is any descender — the tail of a g, y or p — sliced off (descenders_intact)?

Two things happen during free spins that do not happen in the base game: a WILD landing on certain reels EXPANDS to cover that whole reel, and a MULTIPLIER is displayed directly above the reels for the duration of the bonus. The ACTION TIMELINE marks the trigger and every free-spin round — use it rather than guessing which round is on screen.
Judge ONLY the free-spin rounds unless a question says otherwise; the base game before the trigger has no expansion and no multiplier, and is not the subject.
THE EXPANSION. (1) expansion_seen: during the free spins, does at least one reel visibly fill with WILD symbols — an expansion animation covering the reel top to bottom? (2) expansion_covers_whole_reel: where that happens, does the wild cover the FULL height of the reel (all three cells), rather than one or two of them? If some cell visibly keeps a different symbol, answer false and say which in `notes`. (3) expansion_in_base_game: BEFORE the trigger, in the base game, does any reel expand to wilds? This should NOT happen — answer true only if you actually see it.
THE MULTIPLIER. (4) multiplier_above_reels: during the free spins, is a multiplier value displayed DIRECTLY ABOVE THE REELS — not in a corner, not only on the first spin? (5) multiplier_same_throughout: does that value stay THE SAME for every free-spin round, rather than changing part-way through? Compare the rounds against each other; do not try to judge whether the number is the "right" one, which is not your question. (6) multiplier_text: read the multiplier exactly as printed and report it as a string (for example "x3"). If you cannot read it clearly, answer "unreadable".
THE AWARD. (7) award_announced: when the bonus starts, does the game announce how many free spins were won — a number shown on an intro banner, a counter, or a message? (8) announced_count_matches: is the number it announces {terminal.total_free_spin}? (9) bonus_symbols_marked: on the triggering spin, are the symbols that caused the trigger visibly marked — highlighted, animated or framed — rather than just sitting on the grid? Do NOT count them; only say whether they are marked.
(10) ui_broken: during the bonus, is anything overlapping, cut off, placeholder or visibly broken?
notes: one short sentence on anything you saw that the questions above do not cover.

(3) wheel_after_reveal: is the multiplier wheel offered AFTER that reel spin and BEFORE the first free spin? Answer false if it appears before the reel spin, or not at all.
(4) multiplier_above_reels: once the free spins are running, is the multiplier value displayed DIRECTLY ABOVE THE REELS — not in a corner, not only inside the wheel popup, and not only on the first spin?

(5) does any text OVERFLOW its frame or OVERLAP another UI element (text_overflow)? (6) is any text visibly CUT OFF at an edge, truncated mid-word, or hidden behind another element (text_clipped)? (8) is any string a raw translation KEY or placeholder instead of real words, e.g. "btn_spin", "MISSING_KEY", "???" (placeholder_text)? ok.title: Reopening the game after a losing round restores that round: its stake, and no win

video.prompt:
Mystic is a 7x7 cluster-pays slot: wins are CLUSTERS of touching symbols, which clear and let new symbols fall in, so a round settles several times before it ends. This clip has TWO PHASES separated by a game RELOAD, and the question is whether the second matches the first. The ACTION TIMELINE gives the moment of the reload and the moment the game came back ready — use it rather than guessing where the break is.
PHASE 1, before the reload: the player's last round, which LOST. Stake 1, win 0.6. It is held on screen for a few seconds once it has fully settled.
PHASE 2, after the reload: the game is closed and reopened, then sits ready for a few seconds. It is expected to come back showing the SAME round.
Judge phase 2 against phase 1 and answer each independently:
(1) reload_visible: does the clip actually contain a reload — the game goes to a loading or blank state and then re-enters? Answer false if no such break occurs.
(2) bet_amount_same: does the bet / stake readout after the reload show the same value it showed before it? Judge the bet readout only — ignore the balance, which moves for other reasons.
(3) no_win_after_reload: after the reload, is the screen free of any win presentation — no win amount displayed, no cluster highlighted, no celebration — matching the losing round in phase 1?
(4) symbols_same: look at the SYMBOLS ON THE BOARD, 7 by 7. After the reload, is every position showing the SAME SYMBOL as the SETTLED board at the end of phase 1's round — not an earlier cascade step? Compare cell by cell, not as an overall impression.
(5) ui_broken: after the reload, is anything overlapping, cut off, placeholder or visibly broken?

ok.title: All in-game text follows the player's chosen language

image.prompt:
A Zeus UI surface, captured as: {shot.label}. Zeus is a 3x3 slot with 5 paylines. That label gives the language code and name, the surface shown, and — after a mid-session change — the language it switched FROM. Judge the screen against the language the label names, at full resolution, and answer three groups of questions. Expected scripts: Burmese = Myanmar, Simplified Chinese = Han, Russian = Cyrillic, English = Latin.
LANGUAGE. (1) is all visible text rendered in the language the label names, rather than English fallback or the language it switched from (correct_language)? (2) is any string left untranslated — a word in a different language from the one the label names (untranslated_strings)? (3) is any raw translation key visible, text like "ui.button.spin" or "MISSING_KEY" (raw_keys_visible)? Ignore numbers, currency amounts, currency codes such as (TRY), and the game's brand name.
LAYOUT. (4) does any text overflow outside its button, panel or label boundary (text_overflows)? (5) does any text run underneath or on top of another element (text_collides)?
GLYPHS — examine the characters closely, and answer only about the characters themselves. (6) is any character cut off at the top or bottom of its line (glyphs_clipped)? (7) for scripts with marks above or below the base letter (Burmese especially), are those marks fully rendered (diacritics_intact)? (8) is any descender — the tail of a g, y or p — sliced off (descenders_intact)?
